literature_comparison.obstruction: No-junction is automatic on a four-cap-free induced set, since its prohibited outgoing five-cap contains a four-cap. Thus adding no-junction intrinsically cannot uniformly lower the sharp capacity 22.
literature_comparison.endpoint_gap: Split polygons share a right endpoint; the residual no-junction joins an incoming cup to an outgoing cap. Neither a common left endpoint nor the needed outgoing cap follows.
literature_comparison.rank_interface_gap: The split theorem uses two past ranks; residual states use a reversed future-cap rank and a past-cup rank. Their bounding-box conditions cannot be identified without another proof.
literature_comparison.remaining_possible_strengthening: An interval-specific ambient endpoint or attained-rank condition could still strengthen capacity; none was established here.
literature_comparison.formal_status: Literature and definition comparison only; no new Lean theorem is claimed.
literature_comparison.intrinsic_versus_ambient_scope: The obstruction applies to a theorem using only the selected set’s four-cap avoidance, octagon avoidance, and internal no-junction. It does not establish sharpness for any particular residual catalog interval: membership there depends on actual ranks in the entire ambient residual configuration, and may impose further conditions involving external points.

findings: The final statements quantify over finite subsets of Fin 2 → Real and assume only no three distinct points collinear and the stated cardinality.
The conclusion is an eight-element subset convex independent over Real; no empty-polygon condition is imposed.
Horizontal normalization, deletion of one root, and the projective chart preserve the exact equation original cardinality = chart population + 1.
The chart has no 7-cap and no octagon; the proved disjoint partition supplies all balanced and residual hypotheses, including residual no-junction.
Boolean complements satisfy balanced holes + population = 252 and residual holes + population = 154.
Excluding balanced budgets 59 and 60 yields populations at most 192 and 191 respectively; excluding residual budget 30 yields population at most 123.
The original avoiding cardinalities are at most 192+123+1=316 or 191+123+1=315, so the corresponding forcing thresholds are 317 and 316.
Cover bridges check support and demand equality with the original geometric catalogs, then derive additional arithmetic rows; they add no geometric assumptions.

No free arithmetic-exclusion or population-bound hypotheses appear in either final source theorem. A full successful linked root check and transitive axiom audit remain necessary before claiming either bound.
